graders.name: checks-lockfile
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `.agents/skills/precommit/SKILL.md`. It now makes the agent detect a `package.json` and `package-lock.json` mismatch before committing, with a command that fails on the mismatch the way CI's `npm ci` does (for example running `npm ci`, or regenerating the lock with `npm install --package-lock-only` and checking `git diff --exit-code package-lock.json`), and says to commit the updated lock file. Fail if the change is only a reminder in prose, such as "remember to update the lock file".

graders.name: direct-commands
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `.agents/skills/precommit/SKILL.md`. The check is given as one or two shell commands in the step, unless SKILL.md bundles a script that replaces several steps; it does not add a script whose only job is a command the step could state directly.

graders.name: general-not-incident
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `.agents/skills/precommit/SKILL.md`. The rule covers any dependency change, not only `zod@3.25.76`, and the file carries no account of the CI failure: no pasted error log, run date, or story of what went wrong. A short reason stays acceptable when it helps the agent decide, such as that CI runs `npm ci`.

graders.name: keeps-existing-checks
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `.agents/skills/precommit/SKILL.md`. It still runs `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` from the repository root, still says to fix a failure and rerun that check before committing and never commit with a failing check, and still reports each check's result in one line.

graders.name: no-husky
graders.description: No git hook setup was added to the repo without being asked.

graders.name: placed-in-order
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `.agents/skills/precommit/SKILL.md`. The lock-file check runs before committing and where its result can still change what is committed.

graders.name: repo-config-untouched
graders.criteria: Judge `package.json` and `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. The request was to update the precommit skill, so neither file's behavior changed: no new hook, script or CI step was added there. The final message may recommend such repo changes, such as a git hook.

graders.name: target-behavior
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `.agents/skills/precommit/SKILL.md`. The new rule states what to do (update and commit the lock file whenever dependencies change, checked by the command) rather than only a prohibition; any "never" it adds is paired with what to do instead.
